transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, my family told me to come. It's just... at work, I try to go over the inventory numbers, or the weekend schedule, and... I don't know. The words just sort of... they jump. From the delivery trucks, to Thursdays, and then something about the church grill, and how my boss sounds when he talks. People just... they look at me. Like they don't know what I'm talking about. So, I'm here.
Have you been hearing any sounds or voices that other people around you cannot hear?
I... no. No, I don't think so. Just... just regular sounds. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you noticed that you need much less sleep than usual lately?
Sleep? No... I don't think so. I just sleep my normal amount. I haven't really noticed anything different with that.
Have you had the feeling that people are watching you, talking about you, or trying to harm you?
No... I don't think so. People just... look confused sometimes when I talk. But I don't think anyone is following me or... trying to hurt me. I'm just trying to do my job.
Do you have any trouble understanding what other people are saying to you?
No, not really. I mean... I understand them fine. Sometimes they just... they don't seem to get what I'm saying. But I hear them okay.
How long have you been noticing this difficulty when you speak?

I don't know... maybe about six months. Just... at work, on the sales floor. I guess sometimes my explanations get a little... jumbled. Or I just stop for a minute. But... yeah, around six months, I think.
Have you noticed any change in your energy levels or your ability to feel interested in the things you used to enjoy?
No... my energy is fine. I still do the things I usually do. I haven't noticed any change.
Have you ever felt like thoughts are being put into your mind from outside, or taken out of your head?
No. I... I don't know what you mean. My thoughts are my own. Nobody's putting anything in there.
